text:
samir: heads up — running into a native extension build failure when installing the ruby SDK gem on macOS (Homebrew Ruby + Bundler 3). minimal repro and error below. opened a small PR (#412) with a potential patch but would love a quick review and sanity check before we merge to avoid breaking quickstarts.

mara: can you paste the exact install log and the ruby version? mac arm vs intel matters here. we had an ffi/lea issue last month.

samir: sure — this is on macOS 13.6, Homebrew Ruby 3.2.5, Bundler 3.5.2. repro: `brew install ruby; gem install bundler; gem install redwood-inference`

samir: error snippet:
```
Building native extension for redwood-inference...
current directory: /Users/samir/.gem/ruby/3.2.0/gems/redwood-inference-0.6.2/ext/ext_conf
ld: library not found for -lruby
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
make: *** [redwood_ext.bundle] Error 1
```

jules: hmm looks like the header/lib paths from Homebrew aren't being picked up by the extconf. try `gem install redwood-inference -- --with-ruby-include=$(brew --prefix ruby)/include/ruby-3.2.0 --with-ruby-lib=$(brew --prefix ruby)/lib` and see if that changes anything.

mara: also check `RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS` or `LDFLAGS` env in the CI matrix. we used to add `-L$(brew --prefix ruby)/lib` for macos workflows.

samir: tried the flags, that lets it link locally. PR #412 adds a fallback search in extconf to prefer Homebrew prefix when present and documents the manual flags in the quickstart.

cami: I can take a look at the PR this afternoon. @mara @jules if either of you want to eyeball the extconf change that would be great — don't want to introduce a hack that breaks non-homebrew installs. :+1:

rubygem-bot: CI started for PR #412 (ruby 3.0, 3.1, 3.2 matrix) — macos-latest job queued.

ci-bot: macos-latest/job-7 failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/prs/412/log — failure is the same linker error on macos-latest (intel) but passes in linux.

jules: if CI still fails on macos-latest we should add a macos-only job that sets `--with-ruby-lib` and see if that stabilizes until we get a better detection. also add a short note in CHANGELOG about native ext behavior for Homebrew users.

cami: reviewing now. small nits around comments and a test for ext loading fallback would be ideal. i'll request changes if tests missing.

samir: great, thanks all — pushed an extra test that attempts to load the extension via the discovered paths, and added docs under quickstarts/ruby.md. i'll address any review comments.

mara: thanks for the quick writeup and repro steps — super helpful for maintainers onboarding. can we also add a short troubleshooting snippet to the sampleapp README? new users hit this during local dev a lot.

samir: will add to sampleapp README in the same PR.

cami: left a few small comments, but LGTM after the test tweak. thanks! :shipit:

samir: awesome, merging after CI green. will ping #devex when I'm done so docs team can pick up the quickstart update.
